title: Tessli UI rule
description: The YAML frontmatter of rules/<ID>.md (plan §6.5). web/scripts/build-registry.mjs validates every rule against this schema, checks that the id prefix matches the category, and generates rules/TESSLI.md and web/data/rules.json from the rule files.

id.description: Stable rule id: a category prefix, a hyphen and two digits (H-01). Equals the file name, is never renamed and is never reused.

category.description: hierarchy (H), typography (T), spacing (S: spacing and density), colour (C), components (K), copy (W: copy and writing), states (ST), responsive (R), motion (M), accessibility (A).

title.description: A short name for the rule.

statement.description: The rule as one imperative line. Terse, because rules/TESSLI.md quotes it.

why.description: Why it matters, in one to three sentences.

check.description: How to verify it: concrete and observable, ideally at 1440, 768 and 390 px. Terse, because rules/TESSLI.md quotes it.

anti_pattern.description: The common generic default this rule guards against.

status.description: draft until a maintainer signs the rule. Only maintainers set reviewed.

reviewed_by.description: GitHub handles of the reviewing maintainers. Empty while the rule is a draft.

sources.description: Where the rule comes from: real, checkable origins only (a design.md or docs section, a WCAG 2.2 success criterion, a plan section, a review dimension). No unsourced studies or statistics.
